assertions.name: primary-scroll-independence
assertions.expected: main content scrolls without moving pane outside its sticky range

assertions.name: internal-scroll-only-when-needed
assertions.expected: pane scrolls internally only when content exceeds available viewport height

assertions.name: narrow-fallback
assertions.expected: pane becomes non-sticky stacked or equivalent when width is insufficient

assertions.name: viewport-reduction
assertions.expected: all pane controls remain reachable after viewport height reduction

assertions.name: ancestor-overflow
assertions.expected: unintended ancestors do not silently destroy sticky behavior

assertions.name: touch-scroll
assertions.expected: touch scrolling is not trapped when the gesture begins outside the pane
